scenes: Someone collapses in the heat. | What helps first?
Cooling them, as fast as possible. | Heatstroke is an emergency, and every minute of cooling counts.
Move them to shade. | Cool the body with water and fanning. | Call for help. | And if they are awake and can swallow, small sips of water.
Confusion is a warning sign: | hot skin and confusion together can mean heatstroke.
